pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal regions with sharply serrated, leaf-like edges. The pixel gradients at the patch boundaries are high-contrast. Patch size is largest on the upper shoulder and neck, decreasing in area toward the lower limbs and posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of narrow cream-colored pathways forming a reticulated lattice. Junction nodes typically connect 3 to 4 patches. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible flank, with slight narrowing at vertex intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background sky and foliage.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two small avian figures (oxpeckers) perched on the giraffe: one on the upper shoulder/neck junction and one on the mid-dorsal flank.
